description:
Context

CNES-CSG wants to digitalize its activities in order to :
•	Reduce reconfiguration delay in between two launches
•	Maintenance and Operation reduction costs
•	Turn the CSG into an attractive spot for new space operators
•	Improve space base availability
•	Daily life improvement and simplification

Description

CNES intends to optimize the technical management of its networks. The aim is to reduce the number of network managers, and so reduce operating costs, maintaining a high level of security

CNES has undergone a PoC (proof of concept), beginning coding of the core of a SIA

The activity will consist in technical assistance to carry on the coding to generalize the functionalities, and validate the cybersecurity level.

Inputs will consist in 
-	a requirement specification or a technical specification
-	the results of a PoC (proof of concept) developed internally CNES, if available
Delivery will consist in the full coded SIA, qualified for operations and compliant with ISS (Information System Security).
